items.value: Item that works well in right hands.
Allows player to blow wind like Cloudy Copter for a few seconds! However, it is worth remembering that you can turn off it to keep the wind.
Teleports any npc like Dangerous Teleporter does that, works as projectile.
Gives you immunity only from Baldi while you are sliding!
Blows strong wind when it is active!
Creates teleportation hole which teleports everyone while it is not closed!
Stops time for a few seconds, while time is stopped entities can't interact with you.
While player is flying by using this balloon, they can't interact with entities.
Gives guilt for npc or player who is stepped on this.
A delicious bread which with some chance can give speed effect for player!
I wouldn't recommend eat this until it will be cooked on Kitchen Stove.
Excellent fried chicken that will feed any NPC or player.
Helps you to throw NPCs back. You can also break windows by using the glove or pushing NPCs into them.
Creates portal which can be connected with other one.
